definition: ζόφος, -ου, ὁ (akin to γνόφος, which see), [in Sm.: Exo.10:22, Job.28:3, Psa.11:2 91:6, Isa.59:9 * ;] in Hom, the gloom of the under-world; hence, darkness, deep gloom (poët. and late prose writers): Heb.12:18, 2Pe.2:4 2:17, Ju 6 13.† ὁμίχλη, -ης, ἡ,  [in LXX for עֲרָפֶל, etc. ;] a mist: 2Pe.2:17  SYN.: νέφος, νεφέλη, both thicker than ὁ  (AS)
